title: Specified normalized reconstruction comparison package
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and its completed integral coefficient sheaves [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use strict varying-coefficient derived towers and their constructible and normalized full subcategories [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], and the specified reduction/total-limit adjunctions [det-sp-normalized-equivalence]. Let $D$ be a finite-field datum of characteristic $p\ne\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type schemes over its algebraic closure, and $f=pj:X\to Y$ smooth of pure dimension $d$, with $j:X\to Z$ open and $p:Z\to Y$ proper. Fix the tower geometry $b,o,q$, Tate presentation $w$, reductions $R_X,R_Y$ and normalized equivalences $N_X,N_Y$, a constructibility proof for tower compact support, and a tower right adjoint $G$ with adjunction $a$ and finite comparisons $lv$ [det-sp-tower-gluing, det-sp-tower-gamma]. Then the package Reconstruction of [def-sp-integral-reconstruction-comparison-data] exists for these specified data. In particular its comparisons are normalized by the actual $N_X,N_Y$ units and counits and by the canonical compactification-limit comparison, rather than arbitrary isomorphisms. This assertion contains no transported integral adjunction, finite unit/counit identities, or integral purity isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the normalized equivalence restrictions for the specified NX,NY. Finite type over the field makes X,Y Noetherian. The actual units and counits give fully faithful reductions, reconstruction isomorphisms, inverse equivalences, and the morphism reconstruction identity by unit naturality and cancellation.
Use preservation of normalized towers by the specified adjoints. Hence total limit of G applied to reduction is integral constructible.

Choose quotient-normalized compactification-limit presentations and scalar data. The canonical natural limit comparison followed by towerWord is imageComparison. Reduce it and compose with the actual NY counit to construct leftComparison. The actual NX counit is rightComparison. Their naturality follows from those of the constituent maps; imageComparison proves support_closed. These give exactly Reconstruction, using the argument of the existing reconstruction comparison theorem while retaining the specified NX,NY.

theorem integralAdjunctionReconstruction
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper p]
    [(j ≫ p).IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (j ≫ p)]
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (o : SpTowerShriek.Operations l E b)
    (q : SpTowerCalculus.Coordinates l E b) (w : SpChartAdmissibility.Twists l E X)
    (RX : SpReductionTower l E X (q.abelian X))
    (NX : SpNormalizedEquivalence l E X (q.abelian X) RX)
    (RY : SpReductionTower l E Y (q.abelian Y))
    (NY : SpNormalizedEquivalence l E Y (q.abelian Y) RY)
    (hF : ∀ M : SpTowerCalculus.C l E b q X,
      spConstructibleTorTowers l E Y (q.abelian Y)
        ((SpTowerCalculus.F l E b o q (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p)).obj M.obj))
    (G : SpTowerCalculus.C l E b q Y ⥤ SpTowerCalculus.C l E b q X)
    (a : SpTowerGluing.support l E b o q (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p) hF ⊣ G)
    (lv : SpTowerGluing.Levels l E b o q (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p) hF G a) :
    Nonempty (reconstructionResult l E D j p b o q RX NX RY NY hF G a)
